queries.item: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:ec_table_booking_system` ( `product_id` int(11) NOT NULL, `booking_type` char(1) NOT NULL, `quantity_selector` char(1) NOT NULL, `show_price_date` char(1) NOT NULL, `blocked_date` text NOT NULL, `from_date` varchar(20) NOT NULL, `to_date` varchar(20) NOT NULL, `slot_time` int(11) NOT NULL, `free_time` int(11) NOT NULL, `days_data` text NOT NULL, `minimum_booking_time` text NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`product_id`) ) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=UTF8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:ec_table_booking_system_booking_info` ( `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `order_id` int(11) NOT NULL, `product_id` int(11) NOT NULL, `booking_info` text NOT NULL, `start_date` text NOT NULL, `end_date` text NOT NULL, `slot` text NOT NULL, `quantity` int(11) NOT NULL, `status` char(1) NOT NULL, `booking_type` char(1) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`) ) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=UTF8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:ec_table_booking_system_price` ( `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `product_id` int(11) NOT NULL, `from_date` int(11) NOT NULL, `to_date` int(11) NOT NULL, `price` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`) ) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=UTF8;
ALTER TABLE ?:companies ADD blocked_date text NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE ?:companies ADD booking_data text NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE ?:vendor_plans ADD offer_booking tinyint(1) NOT NULL;
